payload.core_mechanism_summary: Double nested loops: outer over start index i, inner over step size j, checking if positions i, i+j, i+2j, i+3j, i+4j are all platforms.
payload.rationale: Solution exhaustively tries all start indices and gap lengths, a brute-force enumeration. 'Branch and bound' is the closest subtype among candidates, though no bounding is used; it still enumerates all possibilities within loop bounds.
